# ShyonLabs

> ShyonLabs is an independent AI and software product studio based in Pakistan, building useful digital products for a global audience.

## Founder

ShyonLabs was founded by **Shayan Shahid**, a software engineering student and independent builder from Pakistan.

## What ShyonLabs does

ShyonLabs creates web applications, mobile experiences, practical AI tools, and intelligent software systems. The studio focuses on useful products, thoughtful digital experiences, and reliable engineering.

## Current opportunities

ShyonLabs does not currently have any open roles. New opportunities will be listed at https://shyonlabs.tech/opportunities when they become available.
